Supreme Court of the United States
No. 25A1208
GENBIOPRO, INC.,
Applicant
v.
LOUISIANA, ET AL.
O R D E R
UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the
applicant,
IT IS ORDERED that the May 1, 2026 order of the United States
Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, case No. 26-30203, is hereby
administratively stayed until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Monday, May 11, 2026. It is
further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before
Thursday, May 7, 2026, by 5 p.m. (EDT).
/s/ Samuel A. Alito, Jr.
Associate Justice of the Supreme
Court of the United States
Dated this 4th
day of May 2026.
